dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

statusMap.description:
Map of field value to the {@link UiSdlEnhancedCardStatus}.

Example:
Field value 'Successful' can mapped to 'SUCCESS' of {@link UiSdlEnhancedCardStatus}.

tooltipMap.description:
Map of fieldValue to tooltip. Tooltip shows the field value if not set.

Example:
Field value 'SUCCESS' can mapped to 'Successful'

title: Configuration for the status of {@link UiSdlEnhancedCard}
